log: feat: the Barbarians goody-hut action and rule, for any ruleset (#1)
feat: the ChooseResearch player action, for any ruleset (#1)

`Barbarians` and `Rules/GoodyHut/Barbarians` re-export base-goody-hut-barbarians' action and rule, so the same classes serve any ruleset (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008). Civilization's choice of when a hut unleashes barbarians (`unleashesBarbarians`, `BARBARIANS_FROM_CITIES`), the rule ids and their order stay here, and huts play as before.

`PlayerActions/ChooseResearch` (and `PlayerActionts`) re-export base-player-action-choose-research's class, so a base package can use the same class without depending on every advance (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008). It is the same object, so `instanceof` and saved class names are unchanged.

The build installs with pnpm, checks formatting with `--check`, recompiles and fails on stale compiled output, and runs new tests of what the package exports. `core-player`, which `PlayerActions/ChooseResearch` imports, is now declared, and the unused package-lock.json is gone.
